# EARN and freelance service skills — intake pack

- State: QUARANTINED / NOT RUNTIME-ACTIVE
- Skill documents: 21
- Runtime seed additions: 0
- Tool grants: 0
- Discovery policy: WORLDWIDE by default for ordinary EARN, bounty, open-source, freelance, affiliate, and remote-work opportunities.
- Exception: grants and subsidies require eligibility checks against the exact jurisdiction and official call terms.

## Included
- bounty-opportunity-scout — worldwide bounty/task discovery and risk-aware qualification.
- freelance-competitor-research — evidence-backed competitor analysis as a freelance deliverable.
- freelance-content-delivery — client-ready content drafts and SEO metadata.
- open-source-issue-finder — worldwide open-source task discovery.
- freelance-job-filter — worldwide freelance opportunity filtering with listing-level eligibility checks.
- grant-eligibility-checker — global grant discovery with jurisdiction-specific eligibility verification.
- portfolio-case-study-builder — turns verified work into honest, evidence-backed portfolio case studies.
- freelance-service-packager — defines scoped, deliverable-based freelance service offers.
- work-sample-planner — plans bounded demonstration projects for portfolio proof.
- freelance-platform-policy-checker — checks official platform, eligibility, fee, and payout rules.
- remote-job-risk-reviewer — screens remote-work listings for scam indicators and unclear terms.
- freelance-delivery-qa — verifies deliverables against accepted scope and evidence.
- freelance-client-handoff-builder — prepares clear, evidence-backed client handoff packages.
- digital-product-opportunity-validator — tests digital product ideas with public evidence and no-cost experiments.
- digital-product-listing-writer — drafts honest digital product descriptions and FAQs.
- affiliate-disclosure-reviewer — reviews commercial disclosures and substantiated affiliate claims.
- freelance-niche-opportunity-mapper — maps evidence-backed freelance niches to verified skills.
- public-business-prospect-research — researches organizations with public evidence of service needs.
- freelance-discovery-call-planner — prepares structured client discovery agendas and questions.
- freelance-retainer-planner — defines recurring service scope, capacity, and overage terms.
- freelance-project-profitability-checker — calculates project economics from explicit fee and effort inputs.

## Free-only and permission limits
No CashClaw npm package, Stripe integration, HYRVE marketplace, paid SEO tools, paid APIs, scripts, or third-party runtime is imported. No account credentials, cookies, secrets, or wallet material are used. All skills are research/draft-only and grant no tools. No applications, claims, issue comments, PRs, outreach, emails, posting, publishing, invoices, transfers, signing, or payouts are permitted. Use existing CEOAI Spider only for guarded public read-only research; do not create a second crawler.

## Deferred
CashClaw Guard, invoicing, lead generation, email outreach, social publishing, WhatsApp, and landing-page automation were excluded because their workflows require paid services, Stripe, contact-data processing, or external side effects. AIBTC bounty-scanner was excluded because it requires wallet/signing skills and on-chain claim submission; its upstream repository license was not verified in this audit.
